issues.description: The concept is the method that returns the total number of students. In problem_statement.md (line 40) the method is named using snake_case as `get_total_number_of_students()`, while the UML in problem_statement.md (lines 70-72), the template TODO comment in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java, and the solution implementation in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java use the camelCase identifier `getTotalNumberOfStudents()`. A student reading the exercise may be unsure which exact method name to implement and could implement the wrong identifier (snake_case) or question whether the template/skeleton expects a different name, creating unnecessary confusion.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent and follow Java naming conventions: replace the snake_case `get_total_number_of_students()` in problem_statement.md (line 40) with the camelCase `getTotalNumberOfStudents()` so it matches the UML, template TODO, and the solution implementation.
